system: You compare two versions of an IBM 3270 green-screen operator console. Reply with exactly the JSON the schema asks for.
user_text: Version A is the first image, version B the second. List every difference between B and A: changed, added or removed text. For each give what it was in A (before, or '(absent)' if added), what it is in B (after, or '(blank)' if removed), and where (row number or screen area). If the two versions are identical, return an empty changes list: do not invent differences.
